name: Lost Nation Theater Intermediate Camps
description_short: One-week, full-day theater camps for ages 9 and up with some prior experience, run by Lost Nation Theater in Montpelier. Focuses include comedy, stage combat, storytelling and dance-theater, and production camps often end with 1-3 public performances.
refund_policy_summary: All sales final. A 50% non-refundable deposit is required, and the balance is due two weeks before the first day. No refunds once classes begin. Before the start date, partial refunds may be available on a time-based sliding scale.
